title: Structural map from the constant ring presheaf
statement: Let k be a ring, X a topological space, R a sheaf of rings on X [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], and alpha:k -> R(X) a unital ring homomorphism. Define a natural transformation from the constant ring presheaf k to the identity-site pushforward of R by alpha_U = res_{X,U} composed with alpha. Its naturality follows from functoriality of restriction and uniqueness of the map from the initial object op(top).
